svg.title: compose-pr · expanded · 160x48
svg.text: Create PR and Edit PR open as the compose sheet: one-row fields with their labels on the left, the branch row with Base, Compare and Draft on one line,
the description under Write and Preview tabs, and Reviewers as one row until it has focus.
The old dialog was a 36-row frame over 59 rows of content: the Create button was below the fold, and at 100x30 only one row of the description showed.
unit tests for focus, the tab order, the Reviewers summary and its expansion
the parity scenarios, whose writes are unchanged
New issue and Edit issue on the same sheet
The sheet grows with the description up to the screen less the footer and a margin row, and only then scrolls. Expanded with ctrl+o it takes the whole
The last line of the long body.
